components.name: Primary Forest Button
components.description: The main forward action on light setup surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary, #18342a); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fff); font: 500 16px/1 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #264c3e; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(255 111 78 / 35%); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Coral Completion Button
components.description: The committed next action on a dark completion surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-coral { height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ff6f4e; color: #fff; font: 500 16px/1 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-coral:hover { background: #f05d3d; } .ds-btn-coral:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-coral:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid rgb(255 111 78 / 30%); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Selection Card
components.description: The selected state for level and voice choices.
components.css: .ds-choice { width: 100%; min-height: 112px; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; padding: 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: #18342a; color: #fff; text-align: left; font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgb(31 53 43 / 7%); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease; } .ds-choice:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(255 111 78 / 35%); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-choice-mark { width: 28px; height: 28px; flex: 0 0 28px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ffb69f; color: #18342a; } .ds-choice strong { display: block; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-choice small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: #c9d8cf; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Practice Topic Button
components.description: A translucent topic choice inside the forest practice hero.
components.css: .ds-topic { min-height: 56px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 10%); color: #fff; text-align: left; font: 500 14px/1.2 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-topic:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 16%); } .ds-topic:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-topic:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(255 182 159 / 45%); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-topic-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffb69f; color: #18342a; }

components.name: Conversation Composer
components.description: A floating voice-and-text field for the live conversation.
components.html: <label class="ds-composer"><button class="ds-composer-mic" aria-label="Começar a falar">●</button><textarea rows="1" placeholder="Fale em inglês ou digite…"></textarea><button class="ds-composer-send" aria-label="Enviar">↑</button></label>
components.css: .ds-composer { min-height: 56px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; color: #18342a; box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgb(31 53 43 / 14%); outline: 1px solid #dce5dc; } .ds-composer:focus-within { outline: 3px solid rgb(255 111 78 / 28%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-composer textarea { min-height: 36px; flex: 1; resize: none; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 400 16px/1.5 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-composer textarea::placeholder { color: #607268; } .ds-composer-mic, .ds-composer-send { width: 36px; height: 36px; flex: 0 0 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-composer-mic { border: 1px solid #dce5dc; background: #fff; color: #18342a; } .ds-composer-send { border: 0; background: #18342a; color: #fff; } .ds-composer-mic:hover { background: #e9eee7; } .ds-composer-send:hover { background: #264c3e; } .ds-composer-mic:focus-visible, .ds-composer-send:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(255 111 78 / 35%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Conversation Header
components.description: A translucent coach bar with compact session actions and progress.
components.css: .ds-chat-header { min-height: 72px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; background: rgb(245 247 241 / 94%); color: #18342a; border-radius: 16px; font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; backdrop-filter: blur(20px); } .ds-avatar { width: 40px; height: 40px; flex: 0 0 40px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 42% 58% 50% 50%; background: #ffb69f; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chat-copy { min-width: 0; flex: 1; display: grid; } .ds-chat-copy strong { font-size: 14px; } .ds-chat-copy small { color: #607268; font-size: 12px; } .ds-progress { height: 4px; overflow: hidden; margin-top: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #dfe8df; } .ds-progress i { display: block; width: 62%; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: #ff6f4e; } .ds-chat-header button { padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid #dce5dc; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #18342a; font: 500 14px/1 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chat-header button:hover { background: #fff; } .ds-chat-header button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(255 111 78 / 35%); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Fluency feels like stepping into a quiet, welcoming place where speaking can happen without ceremony. Deep forest anchors the experience with adult confidence; cream and paper keep it open and breathable; coral marks the moments where the learner acts, speaks, or advances. The result is warm and personal without becoming childish, classroom-like, or gamified.

The interface alternates between generous ritual surfaces and tightly focused conversation controls. Onboarding and the daily practice home use large editorial statements, organic illustration, and spacious cards. The live conversation narrows to a calm reading column with a persistent coach header and composer. The session summary returns to an immersive forest field so completion feels conclusive but not theatrical.
keyCharacteristics: Deep forest foundations with rare, energetic coral actions.
Oversized, tightly tracked headlines paired with plain, readable body copy.
Soft paper cards, organic portrait geometry, and pill-shaped controls.
One clear action per moment, with voice and text always treated as peers.
Progress shown through short bars, tabular metrics, and honest local-state language.

rules.name: The Coral Means Motion Rule
rules.body: Coral belongs to speaking, progress, focus, or the next committed action; it is not a general decoration color.

rules.name: The Forest Carries Weight Rule
rules.body: Selection, hero emphasis, and completion use forest as a filled surface instead of adding heavier borders or louder type.

rules.name: The Speakable Sentence Rule
rules.body: Headings should sound natural when read aloud and stay compact enough to absorb in one breath.

rules.name: The Scale Before Weight Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with size and spacing; the system uses regular, medium, and semibold weights only.

rules.name: The One Ritual Per View Rule
rules.body: Each surface centers one learner task—set up, choose a topic, speak, or review—without competing navigation.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows should be broad, low-contrast, and tinted toward forest or coral; never use hard black drop shadows.

rules.name: The Hero Owns the Deepest Shadow Rule
rules.body: No ordinary card competes with the daily-practice surface for depth.

rules.name: The Organic Coach Rule
rules.body: Express character through Mia's silhouette and warm internal shapes, not by making every card irregular.

dos: Do keep the experience adult, warm, and practical through restrained color, direct copy, and generous breathing room.
Do use Coral to show voice, progress, focus, or the next committed action.
Do preserve a text path for every voice interaction and a clear voice-state label.
Do align conversation header, message stream, and composer to one narrow reading column.
Do use Mia's organic portrait as the recurring human anchor across setup, practice, conversation, and completion.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences by removing the listening ripple and nonessential shimmer.
donts: Don't turn progress into points, badges, confetti, or a childish game layer.
Don't use Coral as a large background when Night Forest or Quiet Cream should carry the structure.
Don't box every metric or message; prefer dividers, spacing, and tonal hierarchy.
Don't invent pronunciation scoring or visual language that implies analysis beyond the transcript.
Don't introduce hard black shadows, sharp rectangular primary actions, or crowded persistent navigation.
Don't let decorative portraits reduce the available space for the primary action on small screens.
